_README: Every leaf in this file MUST have a `value` and a non-empty `source`. The eval harness refuses to emit a reportable number while any `source` is empty. Fill these from published material before Sept 1 — a cited constraint is worth more to a reviewer than a confident guess.
_units: Probabilities are 0..1. Money is integer paise. Time is hours.

retry_success_by_attempt._note: P(a retry of a previously failed charge succeeds), indexed by attempt number.

retry_timing_multiplier._note: Multiplier on retry_success_by_attempt as a function of hours waited since the failure. Captures salary-cycle and balance-replenishment effects.

failure_reason_recoverability._note: Multiplier by declared failure reason. A hard decline is not a soft decline; treating them alike is the single most common flaw in retry logic.

mandate_paused_by_customer._note: Governs the NUDGE branch only — a charge against a paused mandate is hard-blocked in response-model.frozen.js regardless of this number. A message can still prompt the customer to resume it themselves, since only they hold that switch.

mandate_paused_by_business._note: Deliberately zero for BOTH retry and nudge. The block is on the business side, so contacting the customer accomplishes nothing — the only correct action today is ESCALATE_HUMAN, because no intervention in the current set can call the API that would actually resume it. That gap is documented in README.md as a known limitation, not hidden by giving this a comforting non-zero number.

nudge_conversion._note: P(customer pays within the response window after a non-charging nudge). Applied instead of retry probability, not on top of it.

locale_uplift._note: Multiplier on nudge_conversion when the message is in the customer's own language. This is the project's central India-specific claim and needs the strongest citation in the file.

opt_out_hazard._note: P(customer opts out permanently) per contact. Opt-out is not a neutral outcome — it destroys all future recovery on that customer, so it is priced, not ignored.

intervention_cost_paise._note: Direct cost of firing one intervention.

opt_out_loss_paise._note: Expected forgone future recovery from one opted-out customer. Without this number an agent that spams everyone looks optimal.

response_window_hours._note: How long after an intervention the outcome is scored. Beyond this it is not attributable.
